messages:
leah: quick heads-up 00: noticed a spike in leads from last week's webinar but conversions look shallow on the funnel dashboard (see https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/webinar-funnel) :thinking:
omar: can you paste the cohort filter you used? we have multiple webinar pages with different UTM tags
leah: filter = webinar_date:2024-05-01..2024-05-07 AND utm_campaign=webinar-may. showing 2,100 leads but MQLs only 120
cass: is this the same cohort we used for the benchmark narrative? our benchmark expected ~8% MQL conv after nurture, so 120/2100 (~5.7%) is low but not catastrophic
revops: FYI we rolled out new inbound routing rules yesterday to de-prioritize low-fit leads -> might be dropping them before MQL tag applied
dev-bot: Deploy 2024-05-08T03:10:45Z: inbound-router v2.4.1 by infra-queue (rule: drop_score<0.15 -> route=low_priority)
omar: ah that could be it. the funnel MQL tag happens in downstream job `mql_enrichment` which only processes leads in the primary route
leah: any quick way to validate? maybe query raw leads for the webinar utm and see route assignment
rico: running quick check: ```SELECT route, COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE utm_campaign='webinar-may' AND created_at >= '2024-05-01' GROUP BY route;``` returns primary=450, low_priority=1,650
cass: that's the smoking gun. most webinar leads got classified low_priority by the router
revops: why were webinar leads deprioritized? sounds like a false positive on lead score thresholds
omar: the new rule used a generic score model that hadn't seen webinar-sourced leads; it used behavioral scoring only and flagged a lot as low intent
leah: proposed actions: 1) temporarily route webinar utm to primary for the last 7 days (so mql_enrichment runs) 2) add a conditional override in router to whitelist utm_campaigns that match webinar-* 3) retrain scoring model with webinar signals
rico: I can open an infra revert PR to route historic webinar leads through enrichment (low-risk backfill), but need approval from infra owners
dev-bot: PR created: INFRA-867 "whitelist webinar utm in inbound-router" by rico
cass: also add this to the benchmark narrative doc so product marketing knows conversion changed due to routing, not creative performance
leah: yep I'll update the dashboard note and slide for tomorrow's KPI review. short blurb: "May webinar conversion dip primarily due to inbound routing change; mitigation in progress (INFRA-867)." :memo:
revops: after revert + backfill, let's re-run the cohort metrics and update the weekly KPI card. ping me when done
omar: tag @dev-bot for the staging rollback and I'll run smoke tests
rico: staging revert queued, ETA 2 hours. will post when complete
leah: thanks everyone. follow-ups: rico (backfill PR), cass (doc update), revops (post-backfill validation). I'll circle back in the KPI thread tomorrow :white_check_mark:
